```{r clean up}
df <- data |> 
    mutate(education = case_when(
        education == "ninguno" ~ "none",
        education == "preescolar" ~ "none", #small, merging
        education == "primaria" ~ "primary",
        education == "secundaria" ~ "secondary",
        education == "media_superior" ~ "high_school",
        education == "superior" ~ "bachelor",          
        education == "posgrado" ~ "bachelor", #small, merging
        TRUE ~ education
    )) |>
    mutate(education = factor(
        education, 
        levels = c("none", "primary", "secondary", "high_school", "bachelor"), 
        ordered = TRUE
    )) |> 
    mutate(marital_status = case_when(
        marital_status == "soltero_a"    ~ "single",
        marital_status == "casado_a"     ~ "married",
        marital_status == "divorciado_a" ~ "divorced",
        marital_status == "viudo_a"      ~ "widowed",
        marital_status == "separado_a"   ~ "separated",
        TRUE ~ as.character(marital_status)
    )) |> 
    mutate(marital_status = factor(
        marital_status,
        levels = c("single", "married", "divorced", "separated", "widowed")
    )) |> 
    mutate(diagnosis = factor(diagnosis
    )) |> 
    mutate(gender = factor(gender
    )) |> 
    mutate(month = factor(
        month,
        levels = c("january", "february", "march", "april", "may", "june",
                   "july", "august", "september", "october", "november", "december"),
        ordered = TRUE
    )) |> 
    mutate(occupation = iconv(occupation, from = "latin1", to = "UTF-8"
    ))|> 
    mutate(occupation = str_trim(tolower(occupation))) |>   # clean whitespace + case
    mutate(occupation = case_when(
        occupation == "estudiante"                    ~ "student",
        occupation == "empleado_a"                    ~ "employed",
        
        occupation %in% c("comerciante", "independiente",
                          "negocio propio", "comercio",
                          "trabaja en casa")          ~ "self_employed",
        
        occupation %in% c("ingeniero", "maestro_a", "abogada",
                          "consultora", "auxiliar contable",
                          "contador", "profesor")     ~ "professional",
        
        occupation %in% c("enfermero_a", "interprete medico",
                          "paramedico", "nutriologo_a",
                          "médico")                   ~ "healthcare",
        
        occupation %in% c("conductora de aplicacion", "cocinero",
                          "estilista", "policia",
                          "recepcionista cerrajería", "ventas") ~ "service",
        
        occupation %in% c("pensionado_a", "jubilado_a") ~ "retired",
        occupation %in% c("sin_ocupacion", "incapacitada") ~ "unemployed",
        occupation == "hogar"                         ~ "homemaker",
        
        TRUE ~ occupation   # keep NA and anything unmatched
    )) |> 
    mutate(occupation = factor(occupation
    )) |> 
    mutate(diagnosis = iconv(diagnosis, from = "latin1", to = "UTF-8")) |> 
    mutate(diagnosis = str_trim(tolower(diagnosis))) |> 
    mutate(diagnosis = case_when(
        diagnosis == "problema_de_lenguaje"     ~ "language_problem",
        diagnosis == "violencia_de_genero"    ~ "gender_violence",  
        diagnosis == "ansiedad_generalizada"                                   ~ "generalized_anxiety",
        diagnosis == "depresion"                                               ~ "depression",
        diagnosis == "violencia_familiar"                                      ~ "family_violence",
        diagnosis == "disfuncion_familiar"                                     ~ "family_dysfunction",
        diagnosis == "problema_de_relacion_entre_padres_e_hijos"               ~ "parent_child_relationship_problem",
        diagnosis == "maltrato_fisico_y_o_psicologico_infantil"                ~ "child_physical_or_psychological_abuse",
        diagnosis == "relacion_conflictiva_con_el_conyuge_o_la_pareja"         ~ "conflictual_relationship_with_spouse_or_partner",
        diagnosis == "tdah"                                                    ~ "adhd",
        diagnosis == "maltrato_psicologico_y_o_fisico_por_parte_del_conyuge_o_la_pareja" ~ "spousal_psychological_or_physical_abuse",
        diagnosis == "problema_academico_educativo"                            ~ "academic_educational_problem",
        diagnosis == "duelo"                                                   ~ "grief",
        diagnosis == "problemas_sexuales_y_de_identidad"                       ~ "sexual_and_identity_problems",
        diagnosis == "estres_indicadores"                                      ~ "stress_indicators",
        diagnosis == "condicion_psiquiatrica_indicadores"                      ~ "psychiatric_condition_indicators",
        diagnosis == "abuso_sexual_y_o_violacion_sexual"                       ~ "sexual_abuse_or_rape",
        diagnosis == "explosivo_intermitente_indicadores"                      ~ "intermittent_explosive_indicators",

        diagnosis == "obsesivo_compulsivo"                                     ~ "obsessive_compulsive",
        diagnosis == "violencia_sexual_por_parte_del_conyuge_o_la_pareja"      ~ "spousal_sexual_violence",
        
        TRUE ~ diagnosis
    )) |> 
    mutate(diagnosis = factor(diagnosis))
```

```{r correlations}
cat_vars <- df %>% select(gender, education, occupation, marital_status, diagnosis)

cramers_v_matrix <- function(data) {
  vars <- names(data)
  n <- length(vars)
  m <- matrix(NA, n, n, dimnames = list(vars, vars))
  for (i in 1:n) for (j in 1:n) {
    if (i == j) { m[i,j] <- 1; next }
    tab <- table(data[[i]], data[[j]])
    chi <- suppressWarnings(chisq.test(tab)$statistic)
    m[i,j] <- sqrt(as.numeric(chi) / (sum(tab) * (min(dim(tab)) - 1)))
  }
  m
}

cramers_v_matrix(cat_vars)

cv <- cramers_v_matrix(cat_vars)
plot_ly(x = colnames(cv), y = rownames(cv), z = cv,
        type = 'heatmap', colorscale = 'Blues',
        text = ~round(cv, 2), texttemplate = "%{text}") %>%
  layout(title = "Cramér's V — Association between Categorical Variables")
```

```{r population comparison}
#bin sample
# English labels, in chronological order
age_levels <- c("0–4", "5–9", "10–14", "15–19", "20–24",
                "25–29", "30–34", "35–39", "40–44", "45–49",
                "50–54", "55–59", "60–64", "65–69", "70–74",
                "75–79", "80–84", "85+")

# Breaks to match those bins
age_breaks <- c(0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45,
                50, 55, 60, 65, 70, 75, 80, 85, Inf)

# Spanish → English mapping
spanish_to_english <- c(
  "0 a 4 años"     = "0–4",
  "5 a 9 años"     = "5–9",
  "10 a 14 años"   = "10–14",
  "15 a 19 años"   = "15–19",
  "20 a 24 años"   = "20–24",
  "25 a 29 años"   = "25–29",
  "30 a 34 años"   = "30–34",
  "35 a 39 años"   = "35–39",
  "40 a 44 años"   = "40–44",
  "45 a 49 años"   = "45–49",
  "50 a 54 años"   = "50–54",
  "55 a 59 años"   = "55–59",
  "60 a 64 años"   = "60–64",
  "65 a 69 años"   = "65–69",
  "70 a 74 años"   = "70–74",
  "75 a 79 años"   = "75–79",
  "80 a 84 años"   = "80–84",
  "85 años o más"  = "85+"
)

#read and clean
pop_raw <- read.csv("population.csv", fileEncoding = "UTF-8")

pop <- pop_raw %>%
  select(sex = Sex,
         age_range = `Age.Range`,
         pop_n = Population,
         pop_pct = Percentage) %>%
  mutate(
    sex       = recode(sex, "Hombre" = "male", "Mujer" = "female"),
    age_range = spanish_to_english[age_range],
    age_range = factor(age_range, levels = age_levels)   # <-- ensures order
  ) %>%
  arrange(sex, age_range)

sample <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(age), !is.na(gender)) %>%
  mutate(
    age_range = cut(age, breaks = age_breaks, labels = age_levels,
                    right = FALSE, include.lowest = TRUE),
    sex       = as.character(gender)
  ) %>%
  count(sex, age_range, name = "sample_n") %>%
  group_by(sex, age_range, .drop = FALSE) %>%
  summarise(sample_n = sum(sample_n), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(sample_pct = 100 * sample_n / sum(sample_n))

compare <- pop %>%
  full_join(sample, by = c("sex", "age_range")) %>%
  mutate(
    sample_n   = replace_na(sample_n, 0),
    sample_pct = replace_na(sample_pct, 0),
    diff       = sample_pct - pop_pct
  ) %>%
  arrange(sex, age_range) %>%
  mutate(age_range = factor(age_range, levels = age_levels))

pyramid <- compare %>%
  mutate(
    sample_signed = ifelse(sex == "male", -sample_pct, sample_pct),
    pop_signed    = ifelse(sex == "male", -pop_pct,    pop_pct)
  )

# plot
plot_ly() %>%
  add_bars(
    data = pyramid, y = ~age_range, x = ~pop_signed,
    orientation = 'h', name = 'Population',
    marker = list(color = 'rgba(150,150,150,0.5)'),
    customdata = ~pop_pct,
    hovertemplate = 'Population: %{customdata:.2f}%<extra></extra>'
  ) %>%
  add_bars(
    data = pyramid, y = ~age_range, x = ~sample_signed,
    orientation = 'h', name = 'Sample',
    marker = list(color = ifelse(pyramid$sex == "male", '#636EFA', '#EF553B')),
    customdata = ~sample_pct,
    hovertemplate = 'Sample: %{customdata:.2f}%<extra></extra>'
  ) %>%
  layout(
    title = 'Population Pyramid — Sample vs. Reference Population',
    barmode = 'overlay',

    xaxis = list(
      title = 'Percentage (%)',
      tickvals = seq(-10, 10, 2),
      ticktext = abs(seq(-10, 10, 2)),
      zeroline = TRUE, zerolinecolor = 'black', zerolinewidth = 1
    ),

    yaxis = list(
      title = 'Age',
      categoryorder = 'array',
      categoryarray = age_levels
    ),

    margin = list(t = 90, b = 60, l = 60, r = 140),   # room for right legend

    annotations = list(
      list(x = 0.20, y = 1.10, xref = 'paper', yref = 'paper',
           text = '<b>Male</b>', showarrow = FALSE,
           font = list(size = 14, color = '#636EFA'), xanchor = 'center'),
      list(x = 0.70, y = 1.10, xref = 'paper', yref = 'paper',
           text = '<b>Female</b>', showarrow = FALSE,
           font = list(size = 14, color = '#EF553B'), xanchor = 'center')
    ),

    legend = list(
      orientation = 'v',
      x = 1.02, xanchor = 'left',
      y = 1
    ),

    bargap = 0.05
  )

  
```

```{r temperature model}
temps <- c(13.15, 22.05, 23.4, 26.4, 28.4, 30.85, 28.55, 29.8, 27.15,
           25.25, 20.65, 18.75,   # 2025: Jan–Dec
           14.25, 19.55, 22.8, 23.55, 27.4, 31)  # 2026: Jan–Jun

month_levels <- c("january","february","march","april","may","june",
                  "july","august","september","october","november","december")

counts_by_month_year <- df %>%
  count(year, month) %>%
  mutate(month = factor(month, levels = month_levels))

temp_lookup <- tibble(
  year  = c(rep(2025, 12), rep(2026, 6)),
  month = factor(c(month_levels, month_levels[1:6]), levels = month_levels),
  avg_temp = temps
)

temp_lookup <- temp_lookup %>%
  mutate(month = factor(month, levels = levels(counts_by_month_year$month),
                        ordered = TRUE))

result <- counts_by_month_year %>%
  left_join(temp_lookup, by = c("year", "month"))

print(result)

model <- lm(n ~ avg_temp, data = result)

summary(model) #not significant
```

```{r education}
           line = list(color = "black", width = 1, dash = "dot"))
    ),
    legend = list(title = list(text = ''))
  )

#test for statistically significance
observed <- compare$n
expected <- sum(observed) * compare$pop_pct / 100

chisq.test(x = observed, p = compare$pop_pct / 100) #very significant pero que
```

```{r clusters}
#kmeans because n>10000
#k-prototypes is k-means for categorical and mixed data
df_clean <- df %>%
  select(id, age, gender, education, occupation, marital_status) %>%
  na.omit()

#Cluster 
X <- df_clean %>% select(-id)
set.seed(42)
kp <- kproto(X, k = 6, nstart = 5)

#Attach cluster labels 
df_clean <- df_clean %>% mutate(cluster = factor(kp$cluster))

#Join 
df_clustered <- df %>%
  left_join(df_clean %>% select(id, cluster), by = "id")
```

```{r cluster analysis}
#this is to see the diff from the overall data
profile_clusters <- function(data, var) {
  overall <- data %>%
    count({{ var }}) %>%
    mutate(overall_pct = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
    select({{ var }}, overall_pct)

  data %>%
    count(cluster, {{ var }}) %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    mutate(cluster_pct = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    left_join(overall, by = rlang::as_name(rlang::ensym(var))) %>%
    mutate(diff = round(cluster_pct - overall_pct, 1))
}

clug_gender <- profile_clusters(df_clustered, gender)
clu_edu <- profile_clusters(df_clustered, education)
clu_dig <- profile_clusters(df_clustered, diagnosis)
clu_occ <- profile_clusters(df_clustered, occupation)
clu_ms <- profile_clusters(df_clustered, marital_status)

df_clustered %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    n          = n(),
    age_mean   = round(mean(age, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    age_median = median(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    age_sd     = round(sd(age, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    .groups    = "drop"
  )
```

```{r cluster labels}
cluster_labels <- c(
  "1" = "Middle-aged people struggling with Grief",
  "2" = "Kids struggling with ADHD",
  "3" = "Male highschoolers struggling with Anxiety",
  "4" = "Secondary students struggling with Depression",
  "5" = "Female highschoolers struggling with Depression",
  "6" = "Adults struggling with Partner Conflict")

features <- df_clustered %>% select(age, gender, education, occupation, marital_status)

# Gower distance
gower_dist <- daisy(features, metric = "gower")

# UMAP
set.seed(42)
umap_coords <- umap(as.matrix(gower_dist), n_neighbors = 30, min_dist = 0.1)

umap_df <- data.frame(
  UMAP1   = umap_coords[, 1],
  UMAP2   = umap_coords[, 2],
  cluster = df_clustered$cluster       
) %>%
  mutate(cluster_label = cluster_labels[as.character(cluster)])

plot_ly(
  umap_df,
  x = ~UMAP1, y = ~UMAP2,
  color = ~cluster_label,
  type = 'scatter',
  mode = 'markers',
  marker = list(size = 5, opacity = 0.5),
  colors = 'Set2'
) %>%
  layout(
    title = 'K-prototypes Clusters — UMAP projection',
    xaxis = list(title = 'UMAP 1'),
    yaxis = list(title = 'UMAP 2')
  )
```
